rv.q: This production shines courtesy of a superb script and a whip-smart cast firing on all cylinders under the assured direction of Shana Wride.
The Cottage is a delightful, fast-paced comedy that packs a lot of laughter in, along with some surprisingly insightful moments as well.
The Cottage is definitely a fun time at the theatre and a good date night to unwind and forget about the world for a while.
An evening of laughter to set the season in motion: go for it.
The funny and surprise-filled comedy made its San Diego premiere Saturday at North Coast Repertory Theatre in Solana Beach.

cn.t: Critics find "The Cottage" a crowd-pleasing farce with knockout performances and sharp feminist wit. Jokes may be telegraphed, but the laughs land consistently in this 1920s sex romp.
